newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks seen moving higher in thin trading.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks seen moving higher in thin trading.

text.p: With little news expected and many global markets closed, the Santa Claus rally was expected to continue for U.S. stocks on Thursday in thin trading as investors return after the Christmas holiday.
"I don't think there will be any major announcements and the bias is to move higher in latter part of December," said Prudential Securities' Larry Wachtel.
The Dow added 34 on Tuesday to about 6523, nearing its record closing high and outpacing the broader market as investors sought the safety and liquidity of blue chips.
